🦅 MI HB 4350 — You Can Now Feed Deer & Elk… With Limits

Michigan residents can now legally feed deer and elk under specific conditions.

You can place up to 2 gallons of feed within 300 feet of a residence, but it must comply with USDA standards to prevent disease spread.

Feeding for baiting or agricultural purposes is still prohibited.
